178B.name: Shooter Y position, low
178B.kind: byte table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: Low byte of the Y position of each active shooter (Bullet Bill / Torpedo Ted launcher). Set when the level
loads or scrolls a shooter in (from the adjusted screen boundary). Read by the launchers to place the
sprite they spawn. High byte is $1793.

1793.name: Shooter Y position, high
1793.kind: byte table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: High byte (screen/page, bit 0) of each shooter's Y position; $178B is the low byte. Written when the
shooter is loaded, read when Bullet Bill or Torpedo Ted is spawned so the new sprite starts at the shooter.

179B.name: Shooter X position, low
179B.kind: byte table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: Low byte of each shooter's X position (taken from the high nibble of the level data). High byte is $17A3.
Read by the Bullet Bill and Torpedo Ted shooters to place the spawned sprite and by the shooter smoke code.

17A3.name: Shooter X position, high
17A3.kind: byte table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: High byte (bit 0) of each shooter's X position; $179B is the low byte. Written when the shooter is loaded,
read by the launchers when spawning a sprite and by the smoke helper to compare against the screen.

17AB.name: Shooter timer
17AB.kind: timer table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: Countdown before a shooter fires again. Set to $10 when the shooter is loaded. The shooter loop
decrements it every other frame; Bullet Bill / Torpedo Ted shooters act when it runs out and reload it.
Values: 0 = ready to fire.

17BB.name: Level number, low byte (scratch)
desc: Stored by the level loader as the low byte of the level number (looked up from $19B8, or from the
overworld level number minus $24 when it is $25 or more). Its only reader is a small routine at $00:FF07
that shifts Mario's position by [$17BC]/[$17BB]; it looks unused, so treat the purpose as uncertain.

17BC.name: Layer 1 Y scroll delta
desc: How far layer 1 scrolled vertically this frame (current $1C minus the previous frame's $1464). Written by
the scroll-follow code at $00:F7D3, and adjusted by the scroll routines in bank 5. $17BD is the X counterpart.

17BD.name: Layer 1 X scroll delta
desc: How far layer 1 scrolled horizontally this frame (current $1A minus the previous frame's $1462).
Read by anything that must move with the screen: the layer 3 scroll code, Porcu-Puffer, Fishin' Boo,
clouds, the level-end coin sprite and the layer 3 smash. $17BC is the Y counterpart.

17BE.name: Layer 2 Y scroll delta
desc: How far layer 2 scrolled vertically this frame (previous $20 minus current, so up is positive).
Written by the scroll-follow and scroll-delta routines; read by Mario's block/slope collision.

17BF.name: Layer 2 X scroll delta
desc: How far layer 2 scrolled horizontally this frame (previous $1E minus current, so left is positive).
Set to 0 in the scroll routine when $143F is 1. Read by sprite-block interaction to carry sprites on layer 2.

17C0.name: Smoke sprite type
17C0.kind: byte table, one per smoke slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Type of each 4-slot smoke/effect sprite; 0 means the slot is free. Spawners write it, the smoke main
routine dispatches on it. Timer is $17CC, X position $17C8, Y position $17C4.
Values: 0 = free; 1 = puff; 2 = contact star/puff; 3 = rising puff; 5 = sparkle spawner; $81 = cape smoke.

17C4.name: Smoke sprite Y position
17C4.kind: byte table, one per smoke slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Y position (low byte) of each smoke sprite. Set by the spawner (sprite Y, Mario Y plus offset, block Y).
Type 3 smoke decrements it each update so the puff rises. Slot type is $17C0.

17C8.name: Smoke sprite X position
17C8.kind: byte table, one per smoke slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: X position (low byte) of each smoke sprite, set by the spawner (sprite X, Mario X, block X).
Read when the smoke is drawn. Slot type is $17C0.

17CC.name: Smoke sprite timer
17CC.kind: timer table, one per smoke slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Frame countdown for each smoke sprite. Spawners set it ($1B, $13, $10 or 8 depending on the effect);
the smoke routines count it down and free the slot ($17C0 = 0) at zero. For the sparkle spawner it paces spawns.

17D0.name: Spinning coin slot flag
17D0.kind: flag byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Non-zero while a spinning coin from a block occupies the slot. Set when a coin block is hit, tested by
the spinning coin loop and cleared when the coin finishes. Position/speed live in $17D4, $17D8, $17E0,
Values: 0 = free; 1 = in use.

17D4.name: Spinning coin Y position, low
17D4.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Low byte of the Y position of each block spinning coin; $17E8 is the high byte. Starts at the block's Y
minus $10, then moves by the coin's Y speed ($17D8). Also reused by the shooter smoke helper as a position.

17D8.name: Spinning coin Y speed
17D8.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Signed Y speed of each spinning coin. Starts at $D0 (upward) and gains 3 per frame (gravity).

17E0.name: Spinning coin X position, low
17E0.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Low byte of the coin's X position (copied from the block / bounce sprite). High byte is $17EC.

17E4.name: Spinning coin layer
17E4.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: Which layer the coin's block belongs to, copied from the bounce sprite ([$16C9] bit 7). Used when
converting the coin position to screen coordinates.
Values: 0 = layer 1; 1 = layer 2.

17E8.name: Spinning coin Y position, high
17E8.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: High byte of the coin's Y position; $17D4 is the low byte. Also reused by the shooter smoke helper.

17EC.name: Spinning coin X position, high
17EC.kind: byte table, one per coin slot (index X/Y, 4 slots)
desc: High byte of the coin's X position; $17E0 is the low byte.

17F0.name: Minor extended sprite number
17F0.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Type of each minor extended sprite (small effects: brick pieces, splashes, sparkles, floating Z...).
0 means the slot is free; a sprite deletes itself by clearing it. Free slots are found by scanning, with
$185D as the round-robin fallback when all 12 are full.
Values: 1 = brick piece; 2/5 = star sparkle; 3 = spinning tile; 4 = bounce block piece; 6/8/9 = floating Z;
7 = water splash; $0A = Boo stream tile.

17FC.name: Minor extended sprite Y position, low
17FC.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Low byte of the Y position of each minor extended sprite; $1814 is the high byte. Updated by Y speed
($1820) in the motion routines, or by +1/-1 for splashes and floating Z.

1808.name: Minor extended sprite X position, low
1808.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Low byte of the X position of each minor extended sprite. Moved by X speed ($182C) each frame.
There is no matching high byte; the sprites are clipped to the screen.

1814.name: Minor extended sprite Y position, high
1814.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: High byte of the Y position; $17FC is the low byte. Updated with carry/sign extension from Y speed.

1820.name: Minor extended sprite Y speed
1820.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Signed Y speed of each minor extended sprite. Gravity adds 1 per frame (2 for spinning tiles).
Initial values come from tables (brick pieces, Yoshi egg shards) or are 0 for splashes and sparkles.

182C.name: Minor extended sprite X speed
182C.kind: byte table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Signed X speed of each minor extended sprite. Set by the spawner (brick pieces, egg shards, Boo stream
copies the parent's speed); floating Z decrements it each update.

1850.name: Minor extended sprite timer
1850.kind: timer/counter table, one per slot (index X/Y, 12 slots)
desc: Per-slot timer or animation counter, meaning depends on the sprite type. Most types count it down and
delete themselves at zero (sparkles, spinning tile, Boo stream); water splash and floating Z count up as
an animation frame. Examples: splash spawner sets $17, sparkle $17.

185C.name: Sprite platform contact marker
desc: Set by the moving ledge sprite to its own slot number plus 1 while Mario is in contact with it.
When non-zero, Mario's level collision takes an alternate path. Cleared each time the ledge runs.
Values: 0 = Mario not standing on a ledge.

185D.name: Minor extended sprite round-robin index
desc: Used when all 12 minor extended sprite slots are full: it is decremented and wrapped from 0 back to 11
to choose the slot to overwrite. Shared by block shatter, Yoshi egg, Boo stream, Rip Van Fish and sparkles.

185E.name: Sprite routine scratch
desc: General-purpose scratch byte shared by many sprite routines, with no single meaning. Examples: a count
of platforms Mario stands on (mushroom scales), Yoshi frame / tongue Y offset, the index of the sprite being
eaten, Chuck clone index, GrowingPipeTiles value, and the layer-check index in sprite-block interaction.

185F.name: Sprite touched tile (vertical check)
desc: Acts-like Map16 tile number found at the sprite's position by the vertical block check. Read by Net Koopa,
Magikoopa magic and Directional Coins to react to the tile touched.

1860.name: Sprite touched tile (horizontal check)
desc: Acts-like tile number found by the sprite horizontal block check. Read by kicked shells, Net Koopa
and Directional Coins. See $185F for the vertical check result.

1861.name: Spawn-from-block slot toggle
desc: Used when no free sprite slot exists for an item dropped or spawned from a block: it alternates between
0 and 1 each time, choosing sprite slot $0A or $0B to overwrite.

1862.name: Sprite touched tile page
desc: High byte (page) of the Map16 tile found by the sprite horizontal block check. Read by Magikoopa magic
and Directional Coins as an extra block test; Magikoopa use is probably 'blocked by a special tile'.

1863.name: Cape smoke slot index
desc: Rotating slot index used when Mario gets a cape and all 4 smoke slots ($17C0) are full: decremented
and wrapped to 3 to pick which smoke slot to overwrite.

1865.name: Block coin slot index
desc: Rotating slot index used when a block spawns a spinning coin and all 4 coin slots ($17D0) are in use:
decremented and wrapped to 3 to pick the slot to overwrite.

1866.name: Platform angle sign, sine
desc: High byte of the platform's rotation angle; bit 0 gives the sign used for the sine term. Written and
read by the platform geometry helper (for rotating/line platform interaction with Mario).

1867.name: Platform angle sign, cosine
desc: High byte of the platform angle plus $80; bit 0 gives the sign of the cosine term. Same helper as $1866.

186B.name: Multi-coin block timer
desc: Countdown for the multiple-coin block. Set when the block is hit and given its first coin, decremented
by the bounce sprite loop, and cleared when the bounce sprite turns back into the block.
Values: 0 = timer not running (block is spent after this hit).

186C.name: Sprite off-screen vertical flags
186C.kind: byte table indexed by sprite slot
desc: Non-zero when a sprite is vertically off the screen. Cleared and recomputed by the 'get sprite draw
info' routines in banks 1, 2 and 3; ORed with the horizontal flags ($15A0) to test 'off screen'.
Read by Thwomp, Cheep Cheep, Chuck, wings, Lakitu cloud and others to skip logic or drawing.
Values: 0 = on screen vertically.

1878.name: Climbing net door offset
desc: Signed horizontal offset of Mario from the net door sprite when it starts turning (Mario X minus $10
minus sprite X). Read by Mario's climbing code to compute Mario's spin position around the door.

187A.name: Riding Yoshi flag
desc: Non-zero while Mario is riding Yoshi. Set by the Yoshi mount routine, cleared when Mario dismounts or Yoshi
is lost. Tested in dozens of places: stomp/kick contact, springboards, cape and fireball input, block hits.
Values: 0 = not on Yoshi; non-zero = on Yoshi.

187B.name: Sprite extra state
187B.kind: byte table indexed by sprite slot
desc: General per-sprite extra variable whose meaning depends on the sprite type. Examples: Chuck charge
flag ($20 = charging), Bowser hits-left counter, Yoshi egg 'waiting for Mario' flag, circle radius for
Banzai Bill / ball and chain, changing item cycle timer, line-guide fast variant, shell timers.

1884.name: Parallax sprite layout select
desc: Chooses between two layouts in the parallax background sprite drawing routine: if it equals 1, a
different tile and offset set is used. It is never written in the disassembly, so it stays 0 in the
original game; the use is as a variant switch.
